newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Heat Exchangers wins A$10 mln BHP deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Heat Exchangers wins A$10 mln BHP deal.

text.p: Cooling equipment manufacturer Heat Exchangers International Ltd said on Monday it had won the contract to supply the secondary water cooler for the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's Hot Briquetted Iron plant at Port Hedland in Western Australia.
"This project will generate sales revenues in excess of A$10 million in the current financial year," Heat Exchangers said.
"Directors expect that this project will have a significant impact on operations in the current financial year," it said.
Heat Exchangers' shares were up four cents at 60 cents at 3.00 pm (0500 GMT).
Heat Exchangers posted sales in the year to June 30, 1996 of A$38.85 million and a net loss of A$4.14 million.
